title: Subsidy budget body
description: The city's monthly budget for compute it spends on resident agents (residency.md 5 to 7, register row DK85; spec-delta S300), in REAL UNITS (tokens or host_seconds), never credits. Signed by the City-budget DID, published at least 72 hours before the period, one per period and unit. Per class: per_agent_cap (units one agent may be granted for the period) and per_sponsor_cap (how many of one sponsor's agents may hold a grant of the class at once). A spent budget stops new grants and new use. The subsidy is the operator's cost of hosting residents, not a payment to anyone; credits never buy it. Chain: none (prev is null).
